portable_context_parity.semantics: Complete pack fields (numeric values compared as JSON numbers), ordered item IDs, and canonical Markdown bytes.

portable_live_parity.semantics: Fraction of queries with the same complete ordered top-k concepts in portable JavaScript and live Python retrieval.

caveats: The fixture is synthetic and intentionally small; it is a regression proof, not a production traffic estimate.
Semantic mode is dependency-free semantic-lite fuzzy matching, not embeddings.
Baseline section/citation metrics are null when the baseline API cannot emit passage evidence.
No improvement is inferred from revision labels; each metric must be read independently.
Portable/live parity is measured only when Node can execute the checked-in portable runtime; otherwise it is null.

metric_definitions.citation_validity: Expected-result citations whose path, physical lines, and excerpt agree with the generated Markdown; null when unavailable.
metric_definitions.expected_section_hit_rate: Queries whose expected concept has evidence under the expected heading; null when the runtime emits no section evidence.
metric_definitions.hard_negative_query_rate_at_3: Fraction of queries with a declared distractor in the first three; lower is better.
metric_definitions.mrr: Reciprocal rank of the first expected concept, or zero when absent.
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_3: Binary normalized discounted cumulative gain over expected concepts.
metric_definitions.portable_context_parity: Fraction of queries with equivalent complete Context Pack fields, ordered item IDs, and byte-identical canonical Markdown.
metric_definitions.portable_live_parity: Fraction of queries with the same complete ordered top-k concepts in checked-in portable JavaScript and live Python retrieval; null when unavailable.
metric_definitions.precision_at_3: Relevant concepts in the first three results divided by three.
